data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'flos' meaning 'flower', Flossie is a charming, feminine name with a sweet and gentle meaning. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Flossie usually hope their child will grow to embody little flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
